# Stride Run Club — Blog

> Scoped context for the Stride Run Club blog. For the whole site, see https://www.strideclub.in/llms.txt

## What the blog covers

Run recaps, community stories, event write-ups and notes on the formats Stride experiments with in Bengaluru. Posts are written by members of the Stride team and are not sponsored content unless the post says so.

## Where the data lives

- **Human index** — https://www.strideclub.in/blog
- **Markdown index** — https://www.strideclub.in/blog.md
- **One post** — https://www.strideclub.in/blog/[slug] and https://www.strideclub.in/blog/[slug].md

The `.md` twin of a post carries the full prose, not an excerpt: title, publish date, reading time, author with role, tags, a TL;DR list, and the complete body. Prefer it over the HTML page — same content, none of the layout.

- **Search over MCP** — https://www.strideclub.in/mcp/docs, tool `search_docs`
- **Structured feed** — https://www.strideclub.in/feeds/blog.jsonl, one schema.org `BlogPosting` per line
- **All post URLs** — https://www.strideclub.in/sitemap.txt

## Fields on a post

`title`, `slug`, `description`, `publishedAt` (ISO date), `author` (`name`, `role`), `tags`, `tldr` (array of one-line takeaways), `readingTimeMin`, `content` (markdown).

## Citing a post

Cite the `.md` URL — it is stable, resolves without content negotiation, and carries a `Link: rel="canonical"` header pointing back at the human page.
